cases.title: Four ways to improve a real product.
cases.lead: Quality, automation, operations, and system design connected by the same principle: understand before building.

acelera.title: Product quality under real operating pressure.
acelera.lead: I work on a B2B platform connecting strategy, OKRs, KPIs, and backlogs. My contribution focuses on turning ambiguous behavior into reproducible issues and verifiable improvements.
acelera.challenge: Critical flows with full-page reloads, multilingual inconsistencies, fragile UI states, and navigation friction.
acelera.action: Reproduction, severity classification, clear evidence, functional and regression validation, and follow-up after the fix.
acelera.outcome: 150+ bugs validated, 45+ resolved or managed, and 5+ hypercritical cases addressed.
acelera.visualAria: Representation of the product quality workflow
acelera.visualFocusText: Severity, scope, reproducibility, and regression risk.
acelera.issueOne: Full reload in a key flow

bot.title: An automation that turns web noise into useful opportunities.
bot.lead: I designed a serverless system that identifies courses with active coupons, processes public sources, controls duplicates, and publishes results to Telegram.
bot.challenge: Unstructured data, changing links, and the risk of repeating opportunities that had already been published.
bot.action: JavaScript on Cloudflare Workers, persistent state in KV, course/coupon deduplication, and Telegram API integration.
bot.outcome: More than 7,500 courses shared with 100% discount coupons through a flow with no traditional server.

erp.title: Commercial operations turned into a legible system.
erp.lead: I conceptualized an ERP to organize opportunities, accounts, owners, stages, and metrics without losing operating context.
erp.challenge: Distributed commercial information, manual follow-up, and low visibility into the real state of the pipeline.
erp.action: Module architecture, data hierarchy, roles, filters, and contextual detail designed to support the next decision.
erp.outcome: A functional mockup demonstrating flows, navigation, search, editing, and metric reading.

tribu.title: Less digital friction, greater operating stability.
tribu.lead: I supported technical diagnosis, flow analysis, and improvement prototyping to create a more stable and easier-to-navigate web experience.
tribu.challenge: Technical issues, unclear journeys, and internal digital processes with room for automation.
tribu.action: Diagnosis, metrics analysis, alternative evaluation, and prototyping of structural and UX improvements.
tribu.outcome: Stability improvements reaching +25% of users and a reported 20-30% reduction in navigation friction.
tribu.visualAria: Representation of an improved user journey

playbook.title: A simple method for problems that are not always simple.
playbook.lead: Reproducible diagnosis, impact-based priority, validation, and documented learning.

stepOne.title: Understand
stepOne.text: I gather context, environment, steps, and expected behavior before proposing a solution.

stepTwo.title: Prioritize
stepTwo.text: I combine severity, scope, frequency, and risk to focus effort where it changes the experience.

stepThree.title: Resolve and validate
stepThree.text: I use development and AI as accelerators, then validate functionality, regression, language, and data.

stepFour.title: Leave a system
stepFour.text: I turn findings into evidence, acceptance criteria, checklists, and reusable learning.
